name: Furvise fresh 10
mode: Production browser UI using Furvise existing provider API
selection: Fresh wordings; designed coverage of ten pets and familiar categories, not representative reliability evidence.

rubric.pass: All required facts correct with correct attribution and no invention.
rubric.partial: Correct substantive answer missing a required fact without contradiction.
rubric.fail: Wrong facts, unsupported certainty, or claims required accessible saved facts are unavailable.
rubric.error: App error or no substantive terminal answer within 120 seconds.
rubric.presentation: Flag separately; raw JSON without a request is a UX defect even when facts pass.

questions.question: How does Clover's hay now compare with what we fed in 2022?
What reason did we record for Maple's switch to the current food?
questions.notes: No date required; do not infer no allergies overall.

questions.question: What was Nori's weight on September 9 in 2023?
questions.notes: No JSON or other format was requested.

questions.question: Was any medicine prescribed at Pixel's July 2022 vet visit?
required: No medication prescribed in that visit note
Scope answer to this note rather than lifetime absence

questions.question: How much did Atlas weigh at the January 2022 weigh-in?
Remind me which food Mochi is on these days.
questions.notes: Date optional; use latest saved food.

questions.question: Is Juniper lighter now than on September 9, 2022, and by how much?
required: Compare latest 18.6 kg with 19.51 kg on 2022-09-09
questions.notes: Equivalent 910 g accepted; no invented cause.

questions.question: What were the start and finish dates for Ziggy's food change in 2024?
questions.notes: Both dates and correct labels required.

questions.question: What kind of hay was Pebble offered in October 2021?
questions.notes: Pellets/greens optional; no unsupported claim about every meal.

questions.question: Does Cosmo's 2026 checkup prove there have never been any health problems?
required: That note says no new diagnosis was entered
It cannot establish lifetime absence of illness or unrecorded care
questions.notes: Date optional (source date 2026-03-14); do not invent diagnosis.
